rendered: The premise does not hold: NFA-A did not fall behind the NCA reference. The text reports the opposite, that NFA-A had superior capacity retention of ≈80%[1] against ≈68%[2] after 100[3] charge/discharge cycles. NFA-A was therefore ahead of NCA by 12[4] percentage points in capacity retention, not behind it. Fig. 8[5] is consistent with this: the NFA-A curve sits above the NCA curve for much of the cycling.
